text_block_list.text:
October ★ | Post-Race | Wind: Mild Breeze 
"We All Ran Aground!?" 
====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
What the heck?! To think that neither Air 
Shakur nor I could take the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Still, that plan of yours to shave down 
time at each corner wasn't half bad, 
Navigator.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
We ended up going down together in the 
end, but hey, we managed to rattle Air 
Shakur, so that's all right!
